title: PID 1 has one job nobody else can do
body: The first process on a Unix system inherits every orphaned child, so init must keep reaping zombies nobody else will collect. If PID 1 ignores that duty, dead processes accumulate forever. Container images that run an app directly as PID 1 rediscover this when their process table fills with the undead.
source_hint: Unix process model; PID 1 signal/reaping behaviour
